'''Steve Porth''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 83 from Virginia Beach, Va. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Steve also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 18 in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck); finished 14 in YJ Qualifier.<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001205134500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
